141:t_2:61.en:
$$スザク$$
「He's discussing our next steps with Captain $$オットー$$, Captain $$アムロ$$, and the others.」

141:t_2:62.en:
$$キリコ$$
「...A major battle will come soon.」

141:t_2:63.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Today was probably laying the groundwork for that day.」

141:t_2:66.en:
$n
(But now I can sense it too... Something... something terrible is definitely drawing closer to us...)

141:t_2:70.en: ～$$オーガスタ$$　$$ニュータイプ$$ Research Institute～

141:t_2:72.en:
$$マーサ$$
「$$プロト・プルトゥエルブ$$... That's your name, isn't it? Answer me.」

141:t_2:74.en:
$$マーサ$$
「You are supposed to obey your master's orders.」

141:t_2:75.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「You are not my master. If you want to force me to obey, try reconditioning or torturing me.」

141:t_2:77.en:
$$マーサ$$
「You're too soft, $$アルベルト$$. It seems I made a mistake entrusting her to you.」

141:t_2:78.en:
$$マーサ$$
「You've made no progress in four months... No matter how unsettled the world was, I can only call that negligence.」

141:t_2:81.en:
$$マーサ$$
「At least these four months have shown me how difficult you are to recondition. You are far too complete.」

141:t_2:84.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Because I have no interest in people whose memories can be replaced so easily.」

141:t_2:85.en:
$$マーサ$$
「You'll fight for me with your past still weighing on you.」

141:t_2:87.en:
$$マーサ$$
「I can tell. You were made into a tool by others... by men who know nothing but shedding blood...」

141:t_2:89.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Remember what you were doing before $$ネオ・ジオン$$ took you in...」

141:t_2:91.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Now... Lay bare your painful past. I'll take you away from it.」

141:t_2:92.en:
$$マーサ$$
「And... I'll give you the power to fight...」

141:t_2:95.en:
$$マーサ$$
「This is the result of investigating her past. Now reconditioning will be possible.」

141:t_2:96.en:
$$マーサ$$
「She will give us the power... the power to obtain the $$ユニコーン$$.」

141:t_2:97.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「Do we still need to protect $$ラプラスの箱$$ with the $$連邦政府$$ in this state?」

141:t_2:98.en:
$$マーサ$$
「I no longer expect anything from the $$連邦政府$$. Though I'll keep using it for as long as I can.」

141:t_2:99.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「Then what exactly... do you intend to do once you obtain the $$ユニコーン$$?」

141:t_2:102.en:
$$マーサ$$
「So you knew about it after all. It's an organization that guarded something called the Doctrine in history's shadows, gaining immense power in exchange...」

141:t_2:103.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Heh... It's just like the $$ビスト家$$.」

141:t_2:105.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Its highest authority contacted me. They said they would welcome us into $$クロノ$$ if we handed over $$ラプラスの箱$$.」

141:t_2:107.en:
$$マーサ$$
「In a situation like this, neither the $$ビスト家$$ nor $$アナハイム$$ is invulnerable.」

141:t_2:108.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Then let us use the existence of that Box to ensure our survival.」

141:t_2:110.en:
$$マーサ$$
「You needn't worry about anything else. You'll use $$マリーダ$$ there to carry out my orders.」

141:t_2:112.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Heh... The lion and the unicorn... Both are guardian deities of the $$ビスト家$$...」

141:t_2:113.en:
$$マーサ$$
「$$プルトゥエルブ$$... Protect us, won't you?」

141:t_10:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Are you thinking about $$ギュネイ$$?」

141:t_10:6.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You did everything you could. Whether he can break free of that is up to him.」

141:t_10:7.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...Can he really do it...?」

141:t_10:8.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I don't know... This may sound harsh, but once you meet on the battlefield, don't dwell on anything else.」

141:t_10:9.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Think about staying alive yourself rather than saving him.」

141:t_10:10.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...Even at a time like this, $$バナージ$$ would probably say it... 'Even so...'」

141:t_10:12.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「It's not that he inspired me, but I'll defy the situation too.」

141:t_10:13.en:
$$アムロ$$
「If you have that resolve, I have nothing more to say.」

141:t_10:14.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But don't make $$ファ$$ and $$フォウ$$ grieve for you.」

141:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「He has matured too. He is now a fine commander of $$ロンド・ベル$$'s mobile suit unit.」

141:t_10:18.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I also witnessed your encounter with $$ギュネイ$$...」

141:t_10:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It is a wonderful thing when friendship endures even on opposing sides.」

141:t_10:20.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...We might not exactly be friends...」

141:t_10:21.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「But if he's lost, I want to reach out to him.」

141:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「He is a stubborn man. Once he has decided something, he won't change his mind easily.」

141:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But your words today and his battle with you and $$アムロ$$ caused $$ギュネイ$$ to generate 100 Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$s.」

141:t_10:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course, I will add them to the team's stock.」

141:t_10:25.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So his heart really is wavering...」

141:t_10:26.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ＡＧ$$... If he generates $$Ｚチップ$$s when we fight him again, let me know.」

141:t_10:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I understand. For both our sakes, I hope he generates plenty of $$Ｚチップ$$s.」
